THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
THE NEW UNIFORM
057
79 / Ribbed Cami
Street Minimal
A fitted black ribbed camisole dress with thin straps, worn with a
long slit skirt. Long, loose waves fall past the shoulders as the
model sits with her arms resting on her knees, beside a large
dark leather bag.
80 / Denim Mini
Off Duty
A seated, relaxed pose in a cream ribbed turtleneck, a light-wash
denim mini skirt and knee-high black suede boots. Long, straight
dark hair falls to the waist, with arms crossed as the model sits
on a deep blue sofa in a bright retail interior.
